name: North Fork Payette (Cabarton)
blurb: The Cabarton whitewater run ends at Smiths Ferry. It is distinct from the advanced lower North Fork canyon toward Banks.

sections.notes: The Cabarton run ends at Smiths Ferry. BLM's NF02 guide shows Class III rapids including Howard’s Plunge (III+). The separate lower North Fork canyon toward Banks is advanced whitewater; it is not part of this trip.
sections.accessReview: BLM identifies both Cabarton Bridge and Smiths Ferry access as private. Current permission, operating arrangements and exact landing locations still need confirmation. This corrected reach is held for access review.

notices.title: Cabarton is a separate reach
notices.text: BLM distinguishes the intermediate Cabarton section from the advanced Class V North Fork. The old combined endpoint listing is held until corrected.

distanceEvidence.note: Corrects a conflation of Cabarton and the lower North Fork. BLM route mileages; access permission remains under review.

timing.note: The previous listing combined different North Fork reaches. No reviewed speed/flow calibration is available for Cabarton.
